doc: Wardrobe / closet construction rules. PAX is the reverse-engineerable reference; learn the SYSTEM PRINCIPLE, not IKEA's exact dims (which change).
source: IKEA PAX KOMPLEMENT Planning Guide (frame families, KOMPLEMENT organizers, sliding doors, lighting)
note: Do not blindly copy IKEA dimensions into the software. Learn the system principle.

frame_families.note: PAX uses an 18mm frame. Current standard sizes confirmed by IKEA: 500/750/1000 wide, 350/580 deep, 2010/2360 high.
frame_families.corner_addon: corner frame add-on unit; all PAX frames; 4 adjustable shelves included

interior_organizers_inside_frame.so: THE key correction: drawer boxes, rods, shelves are SEPARATE KOMPLEMENT interior organizers sized to the frame's INNER width/depth, sitting BEHIND the door plane. They are INSIDE the wardrobe, not part of the carcase.
interior_organizers_inside_frame.sized_to: frame inner width + depth; actual dims vary by organizer

drawer.note: KOMPLEMENT drawers are separate interior drawers (50/75/100cm wide x 35/58cm deep). Standard drawer heights H63/90/122/186/250.

mozaik.ClosetRodPosition: distance from the TOP of the rod to the TOP of the opening (p163)
mozaik.ClosetThruBore: whether line-bore holes that line up on the opposite side are treated as thru-bore (p162)

closet_rod.positioning_rule: rod hangs UNDER a structural TOP SHELF; clothes hang below the rod.

hanging_zones.single_hang: one rod high (~1700mm rod, long garments)
hanging_zones.double_hang: two stacked rods (~1050/1100mm each, shorter garments)
hanging_zones.top_shelf: structural fixed shelf above rod (folded items)

closet_rod.hardware_rule: rod is located on the 32mm grid; rail + sockets/rail end supports.

sliding_wardrobe_doors.reference: Hettich TopLine XL + PAX sliding doors
components: door_overlap (leaves must overlap so they don't catch)
sliding_wardrobe_doors.pax_note: PAX sliding doors sold in PAIRS; size refers to total measurement of two doors together; metal frame + panels; soft-closing device.
sliding_wardrobe_doors.frame: aluminium/steel metal frame, panels (wood/glass/mirror) fitted in, leaves ride front and back track

hettich_topline_xl.system: TOP RUNNING sliding door system (floor-to-ceiling, large-format, 'top-last word in sliding perfection')
engineering: running component is extremely SHALLOW, hardly visible; damper behind the profile
bottom guide profile is SET BACK BENEATH the base panel, almost hidden
Silent System damper: slow down doors gently; screws into end cap (no complex formula); auto-activates on first close; cannot be inserted wrongly
centre door opens left AND right; slowed from either direction and pulled to end position
door height adjusted from the FRONT (from the side for ceiling-height); overlay adjusted by any amount with door closed, no tools
floor standing guard so doors can be set down without damage; bottom guide glides up automatically
decorative self-adhesive tapes: champagne, white, black (harmonise visible profile surface)
hettich_topline_xl.application: TopLine XL for top-running large sliding wardrobes; Slideline M = the sliding companion (complementary product)

wardrobe_lighting.note: LED lighting strips fitted in PAX (VERSIDAN) + over-cabinet lighting (TV RODRAG / YTBERG). LED driver (TRADFRI smart / ANSLUTA basic). Add LED groove + wire hole (user requirement).

build_order: interior organizers placed INSIDE frame, behind door plane
rod under top shelf, on System 32 grid
